sentiment.rationale: The document shows strong backward-looking results (AWS reaccelerating to 20.2%, revenue up 12%), but forward guidance is concerning: full-year cash capex is guided to ~$125B with 2026 expected higher, and Q4 includes at least $1B of additional power capacity spend. Management's tone on capacity is aggressive but hedged with structural risks (power bottleneck, chip constraints later). The beat includes $4.3B in one-time charges (FTC settlement, severance) and a $9.5B pretax Anthropic gain below the line, so the organic operating improvement is less clear. The forward outlook is not raised; instead, capex is climbing faster than free cash flow ($14.8B TTM), which pressures valuation. The sentiment score is negative because the raised capex and cautious forward language on margins (AWS margins subject to swings from AI data center depreciation) outweigh the backward-looking beat.
